verdict: INTRINSIC. At matched dimensionality (PCA-50) and full N, VTL beats HOG/Haralick by +0.16-0.19; the learning-curve lead widens with N (incumbents degrade on the imbalanced full set, VTL holds at 0.92). The one open caveat on the classification claim is RESOLVED: the advantage is content, not compactness. Pre-registered prediction inverted (reported as such).
